issues.title: Search results point at wrong line numbers after edits
issues.author: rmcallister
issues.body: After editing a file, search hits report offsets from before the edit until the index is rebuilt by hand.

issues.title: Project config ignored on first run after install
issues.author: tsato
issues.body: A fresh install reads the user config but not the project `.clirc` until the second invocation.

pull_requests.title: Fix chunk offsets after in-place edits (#80)
pull_requests.head: fix/chunker-offsets
pull_requests.author: mei
pull_requests.body:
## Summary

Chunk boundaries were computed from a stale buffer after an in-place edit, so every hit past the edit point reported an offset from the previous revision.

## Changes

- Split on a run of blank lines rather than an exact double newline.

## Notes

Small and contained. Reviewed by Dan, checks green.

pull_requests.title: Read project config on first run (#81)
pull_requests.head: fix/startup-config-read
pull_requests.author: ben
pull_requests.body:
## Summary

Config resolution ran before the project directory was known on a cold install, so the project file was skipped exactly once.

## Changes

- Defer config resolution until the workspace root is resolved.

## Notes

My first change in this area, Mei reviewed it closely. Checks green.

comments.author: mei
comments.body: Went through this carefully with Ben. Happy with it.

pull_requests.title: Stabilise export row ordering
pull_requests.head: fix/csv-writer-ordering
pull_requests.author: dan
pull_requests.body:
## Summary

The shared CSV writer emitted rows in map iteration order, so two runs over identical data produced different files and downstream comparisons flagged spurious differences.

## Changes

- Sorts rows by their first column in `services/export/csv-writer.ts` before writing.

## Notes

This is the shared writer used by every export path in the product. Checks green, and a few people have been asking about it.

comments.author: mei
comments.body: Reads fine. One-line sort, no behaviour change beyond ordering.
